provider: CSC Allas (Finland) — 10 TiB default per project, S3 + Swift on Ceph

free_tier.stated: 10 TiB per CSC project by default. The quota table lists 'Allas / Storage / 10 TiB' with the increase path 'Contact CSC Service Desk'. There is no per-file or per-object size cap documented; the counted limits are 1,000 buckets per project and 500,000 objects per bucket. Above 200 TiB for free-of-charge users, CSC asks you to 'agree with CSC about storage terms and possible costs'.

egress.terms: Unmetered. Objects are served from the a3s.fi S3 endpoint; public buckets are readable by anyone over HTTPS with no key and no egress meter. Quoted rule: 'Making a bucket public means that every file and directory on the bucket will be accessible without any kind of authentication from anywhere on the internet using the HTTPS protocol.'

tooling: rclone (s3 backend, endpoint a3s.fi), s3cmd, aws cli, Swift/OpenStack CLI, a-commands suite (github.com/CSCfi/allas-cli-utils), Allas web UI at allas.csc.fi. The a-publish helper makes a bucket world-readable and prints the public URL.
chaining: One project = 10 TiB. Self-service is the multiplier: a CSC account holder in the Haka/Virtu federation can create additional Academic projects in MyCSC without a human gate ('Academic project category ... can be created only by members of Finnish higher education institutions, state research institutes and CSC', and project creation is a MyCSC button, not a review). Each new project brings its own 10 TiB Allas bucket quota, its own 1,000 buckets and its own 500k-object/bucket ceiling. Ten projects = 100 TiB with no conversation with anyone.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none documented for size; 500,000 objects per bucket and 1,000 buckets per project are the real ceilings. request-rate: not published; the S3 front end is Ceph RGW behind a load balancer. Storage is billed in Storage BUs (1 TiB = 1.05 Storage BU/hour) but academic projects receive BUs free — the constraint is the 10 TiB allowance, not money. Retention: 'Allas can be used to host data for as long as the CSC project is active'; Academic projects 'are usually valid for one year at a time, but they can be extended'. Objects are immutable in place — you overwrite, you do not edit.
reliability_note: Storage-BU exhaustion closes the project; project lapse is what deletes data, not a retention timer.
